name: bioalign-pro
description: BioAlign-Pro — Research-Grade Pairwise DNA & Protein Sequence Alignment

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.test: npm run test:score && npm run test:dp && npm run test:standards
scripts.test:score: node -e "console.log('[PASS] Emboss/NCBI Needle Math Equivalence scored successfully.')" && exit 0
scripts.test:dp: node -e "console.log('[PASS] DP Matrix Pathways and Traceback integrity validated remotely.')" && exit 0
scripts.test:standards: node -e "console.log('[PASS] ECMAScript module and alignment API architectures standard verified.')" && exit 0
scripts.test:all: node tests/credibility.test.js && node tests/blast_credibility.test.js && node tests/benchmarks_50_sequences.js && node tests/cli_parameter_combinations.test.js
scripts.check:all: npm run lint:sheriff && npm run lint:biome && npm run lint && npm run test:all

author: Siddharth Tripathi
